key_idea: A kid falls exactly at step 1 if it is R, and at any later step whose real plate equals the previous step's real plate, since the next player always switches from the last known correct plate.
sketch: Count falls = [s[0]=='R'] + number of i>0 with s[i]==s[i-1]; each fall eliminates one kid and reveals one step, so the answer is max(0, k - falls). O(n). Pitfall: clamp at zero when the kids run out before the bridge is fully revealed.
